title: Ex-cop appears before NBI over alleged ‘cash delivery’ to Dutertes

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., a former security aide of then House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco, appeared before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Monday to submit a sworn affidavit and “evidence” that he allegedly delivered suitcases of cash to Vice President Sara Duterte, former President Rodrigo Duterte, and Davao City 1st District Rep. Paolo Duterte at Velasco’s instruction. In an interview with reporters after appearing at the NBI, Gracioso presented what he called “evidence,” including photos of himself with VP Duterte.
